title: I'll stay with you
content:
To tell you the truth, I’m quite unsure
Whether to continue with you this lil adventure,
For I’m afraid that, for you, its torture,
And talking to me is not the cure.

But I’ve devised a plan to make you smile,
Even if it will cost me an extra mile.
For I haven’t been in touch in quite a while,
And last I give, these words be worthwhile.

This poem would be my last resort:
Please listen to what I have to report.
In your darkness, I want to be your support,
Just when everyone else has left the fort.

Let your anxiety be my anxiety,
Even if we have to fight this absurd society,
Just to prove to you that I’m your friend—
I’ll stay with you ’til the very end.
